description: Consume `packages/proto/schemas/common/v1/code_graph.proto` as the Graph envelope; extend `NodeKind` / `EdgeKind` only with TypeScript-specific kinds (component, hook, re_export). Do not duplicate the envelope. The envelope is co-owned with `go-code-graph`.

requirements.description: Consume the canonical Graph envelope defined in packages/proto/schemas/common/v1/code_graph.proto as the shared data contract co-owned with go-code-graph. Extend NodeKind and EdgeKind exclusively with TypeScript-specific values: NodeKind.COMPONENT, NodeKind.HOOK, and EdgeKind.RE_EXPORT. Do not duplicate, fork, or redefine the envelope structure. All generated protobuf code must be derived from the single source-of-truth proto file. Changes to the envelope must be backward-compatible and coordinated with go-code-graph owners.
requirements.title: Shared Code-Graph Proto Envelope Consumption and Extension

validation.notes: Test that NodeKind enum includes exactly the TS-specific extensions (COMPONENT, HOOK) beyond the base envelope kinds
Test that EdgeKind enum includes RE_EXPORT as the sole TS-specific extension
Test that no duplicate message types exist that shadow the shared envelope definitions
Test proto file import path resolves to packages/proto/schemas/common/v1/code_graph.proto
TCG-PROTO-ENVELOPE: Compile the proto with both typescript-code-graph and go-code-graph extensions and assert no field number collisions
Assert that a Graph message produced by typescript-code-graph can be deserialized by a go-code-graph consumer using the shared envelope
Verify CI fails if code_graph.proto is modified without updating both co-owner scenarios
Proto review sign-off from go-code-graph team confirms no envelope duplication
A single shared proto schema version is referenced in both typescript-code-graph and go-code-graph package manifests
